g.text: (a) Averages and peaks from NASA ISS assembly data (Katuntsev et al. 2004) and Apollo reports. (b) Weir equation, RQ 0.85, 20.4 kJ per litre O₂; all metabolic heat
rejected by sublimation (2.83 MJ/kg); suit leakage and heat leaks ignored. Capacities approximate those of the ISS EMU.
